email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. Your careers page asks for resumes at admin@csmith.com.au, so I am introducing myself for a graduate civil engineer or civil designer role, ideally from your Kilmore office.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work and open to discussing relocation within regional Victoria.

Subdivision roads and drainage like your Lauriston Estate work in Shepparton North is the kind of design I want to grow in. My design work so far is from study, so I would start at a junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could this reach Tom Kerrins or whoever looks after engineering hires, in case a junior role comes up?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I would like to ask whether Chris Smith & Associates has room for a graduate civil engineer or civil designer. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. I am sending it to admin@csmith.com.au because your careers page asks for resumes there.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). Subdivision work like Lauriston Estate, where your team designed the roads and drainage and stayed on for site supervision, is the work I want to learn.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I helped with site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. My design work so far is from study, not a paid role, and I have not designed water or sewer works, so I would start at a junior level.

I live in Melton, so Kilmore is within reach, and I am open to discussing relocation for Shepparton or your other regional offices. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I've attached my resume and would be glad to talk if a junior role comes up.
